description.en: Selecting and positioning an appropriate snare, capturing target tissue with adequate margin and downward pressure with gas aspiration, and closing under direct vision.

criteria.en: Captures tissue inconsistently; requires verbal prompts.
Independent capture with appropriate margin; snare V continuously visualised.
Adapts capture technique to lesion morphology and location; teaches the technique.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of source-canonical ESGE EMR recommendations into trainee-assessable units. The recommendation is what ESGE publishes; the competency is what Evideris uses to score a trainee on. Not enumerated as objects in Tate EMR 2023; this competency frame is Evideris's design.
